GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (21 Oct 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 171)
21 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Japanese Naval Radio-telegraph Installation at Funabashi.
1. There is a requirement by the Allied Forces for additional radio facilities in the Tokyo area. It has been determined by inspection that the Japanese Naval Radio-telegraph installation at Funabashi will best meet the requirements of projected Allied operations. Accordingly, the Japanese Government will make the subject installation available for immediate use by occupation forces under the control of this Headquarters.
2. It is directed that the Board of Communications make arrangements to provide an adequate staff of transmitter attendant and maintenance technicians. Japanese Navy technical personnel who are trained in the operation and maintenance of the equipment may be employed in a civilian status.
3. For the present, the Japanese Navy may continue to operate authorized circuits from this station.
4. Details of these arrangements will be coordinated with the Chief, Civil Communications Section of this Headquarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
